kv9.11:1.3: nanu atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vigataṃ viparinataṃ atthaṅgataṃ abbhatthaṅgatanti.
kv9.11:1.5: hañci atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vigataṃ viparinataṃ atthaṅgataṃ abbhatthaṅgataṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv9.11:2.3: nanu anāgataṃ ajātaṃ abhūtaṃ asañjātaṃ anibbattaṃ anabhinibbattaṃ apātubhūtanti.
kv9.11:2.5: hañci anāgataṃ. ajātaṃ abhūtaṃ asañjātaṃ anibbattaṃ anabhinibbattaṃ apātubhūtaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv9.11:3.1: atītena rūpakkhandhena samannāgato anāgatena rūpakkhandhena samannāgato paccuppannena rūpakkhandhena samannāgato’ti.
kv9.11:3.5: atītehi pañcahi khandhehi samannāgato anāgatehi pañcahi khandhehi samannāgato paccuppannehi pañcahi khandhehi samannāgato’ti.
kv9.11:4.1: atītena cakkhāyatanena samannāgato, anāgatena cakkhāyatanena samannāgato, paccuppannena cakkhāyatanena samannāgato’ti.
kv9.11:4.5: atītehi dvādasahi āyatanehi samannāgato, anāgatehi dvādasahi āyatanehi samannāgato, paccuppannehi dvādasahi āyatanehi samannāgato’ti.
kv9.11:5.1: atītāya cakkhudhātuyā samannāgato, anāgatāya cakkhudhātuyā samannāgato, paccuppannāya cakkhudhātuyā samannāgato’ti.
kv9.11:5.5: atītāhi aṭṭhārasahi dhātūhi samannāgato, anāgatāhi aṭṭhārasahi dhātūhi samannāgato, paccuppannāhi aṭṭhārasahi dhātūhi samannāgato’ti.
kv9.11:6.1: atītena cakkhundriyena samannāgato, anāgatena cakkhundriyena samannāgato, paccuppannena cakkhundriyena samannāgato’ti.
kv9.11:6.5: atītehi bāvīsatindriyehi samannāgato, anāgatehi bāvīsatindriyehi samannāgato, paccuppannehi bāvīsatindriyehi samannāgato’ti.
kv9.11:7.4: nanu atthī aṭṭhavimokkhajhāyī, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ nikāmalābhī, navannaṃ anupubbavihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī’ti.
kv9.11:7.6: hañci, atthī aṭṭhavimokkhajhāyī, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ nikāmalābhī, navannaṃ anupubbavihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī, tena vata re vattabbe:
kv9.11:8.1: ānisaṃsadassāvissa saññojanānaṃ pahānaṃ, amatārammaṇaṃ saññojanaṃ, rūpaṃ sārammaṇaṃ, anusayā anārammaṇā, evamevaṃ ñāṇaṃ, atītānāgatārammaṇaṃ cittaṃ, sabbaṃ cittaṃ vitakkānupatitaṃ, sabbaso vitakkayato vicārayato vitakkavipphārasaddo, na yathācittassa vācā, tatheva kāyakammaṃ, atītānāgatehi samannāgato’ti. dasamo vaggo.
